Maya: Heads-up — AstraLedger onboarding: production traffic is up 12% week-over-week and their p95 latency is edging past our target (820ms today). CS flagged rising costs too. Thinking we propose an adaptive inference plan: small quantized model canary + request routing by latency buckets. Want engineering buy-in before we present to the customer tomorrow.

Jon: Can we do a canary that only targets 10% of traffic and only short user prompts? That'll limit exposure. Also want automated quality checks against their eval set.

Maya: Yep — propose 10% canary, only for prompts < 300 tokens. We'll capture top-k responses and run our eval hooks. Sam (AstraLedger) said they care about semantic drift more than raw BLEU.

Ravi: I'll own customer comms and the enablement doc. We should include rollback steps and a short training session for their ML lead. Can we run a preflight A/B on their sandbox tomorrow morning?

Jon: Agreed. Draft of runtime config we can use (simple):

```
model_variant: "gptx-8q8b"
route_policy:
  - type: latency_bucket
    threshold_ms: 600
    percent: 70
  - type: cost_fallback
    percent: 30
canary: 10
eval_hook: "/checks/semantic-similarity"
token_limit: 300
```

Jon: That routes the lowest-latency requests to the quantized variant, falls back for heavy cases, and only splits 10% for the canary. We should also pin a higher-capacity unquantized variant for user-facing fallthrough.

Leah: From infra: need observability flags and alert thresholds on quality delta and error rate. Will add a dashboard tile with: p50/p95/p99, error %, and semantic-similarity rolling mean. Alert if semantic-similarity drops > 0.08 relative to baseline. Also enable automatic rollback after 5 consecutive alert windows.

Maya: Perfect. Ravi — include the following in enablement: playbook steps, contact matrix, and a quick-runbook for rollback. Sam, would AstraLedger be comfortable with a canary window of 48 hours? We can stop earlier if quality regresses.

Sam: 48h window sounds fine. We need visibility into the eval scores in real time. Also please avoid tokenization changes that could affect charges.

Ravi: Noted — we will not change tokenization. We'll set up a shared dashboard and give AstraLedger viewer access. I'll schedule a 30-min runbook walkthru post-canary.

Jon: One more engineering note: we'll instrument KV-cache warmup for the quantized variant to reduce initial latency spikes. Deploy-bot — can you start a canary after we push the routing config?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for thread 2139123456 — canary=10% target endpoints: redwood://astra/edge1, redwood://astra/edge2. Monitoring hooks registered.

Leah: I'll keep an eye on infra metrics and will post alerts in this thread if anything looks off.

Maya: Next steps: (1) Jon: finalize canary config + QA tests (2) Leah: dashboard + rollback automation (3) Ravi: customer enablement doc + walkthru invite (4) Sam: confirm sandbox dataset availability. We'll reconvene after 6 hours to verify readiness. Thanks all :rocket:
